snippet.title: Sonic Racing: CrossWorlds - Accolades Trailer
snippet.description:
The race results are in! Sonic Racing: CrossWorlds is a winner!
 
"My new favorite kart racing game of all time" -IGN
 
And we're in it for the long haul - pick up the Digital Deluxe edition to secure access to all of the iconic guest characters, vehicles, courses, and more from some of your favorite entertainment franchises.
 
Sonic Racing: CrossWorlds is available now: RaceCrossWorlds.com
